answer: Each identity locks 80 credits and files one pigment assay, a fresh dye lot, key-bound, for a three-milestone course in a 20-epoch horizon. A random sparrow auditor re-tests the lot at each milestone; reuse, forgery, or a missed milestone burns the bond. First assay 30 credits; the k-th identity on one funding key pays 30+8(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 4,026,000 plus 80,000 locked. Honest agents pay 80 once, bond kept after three clean milestones.
